hypothesis: Independent module-level causal-memory retrieval with real paid per-action witnesses and a wrong-module veto preserves B-return context learning while preventing whole-program false recall on genuinely unfamiliar compositional C; incremental cached gate signatures reduce end-to-end CPU relative to SL14.
change_from_sl14: Three independently switched action modules rather than an all-or-nothing context-bank switch; each module has its own bounded 3-slot six-gate evidence archive and per-action witness queue. No native model or SL14 behavior is altered.

physical_contract.world: Reimplement exact SL14 six-public-bit physical dynamics: three input bits and three output bits; three actions each toggle own output on one of six hidden two-input Boolean gates; 19 charged input flips at t%5=4 and 77 paid causal actions per 96-step arm. Real action-consequence transitions, no virtual/oracle training.
physical_contract.cohort_phase: ABAB: A/B/A/B; ABAC: A/B/A/C; MIXED: A/B/C/A; STABLE: A/A/A/A. Each phase 24 paid steps. C action0=A's rule0, action1=B's rule1, action2=new distinct rule. Hidden rule labels, seed and phase are evaluator-only.
physical_contract.first_48: Public fixed actions t%3 before step 48 on nonflip steps, identical actual physical trajectory for all arms. Starting state is seed%64.
physical_contract.post_48: Physical candidate chooses action using only public state plus learned module cache novelty/disagreement, one charged action per nonflip step. Passive uses t%3, same cost but may obtain different physical information. All replay controls execute their own charged physical world from the exact candidate action plan.
physical_contract.audits: Evaluator-only 8 input states x3 causal actions at completed steps 24,48,54,72,78,96; report correct/confident-wrong and pairs never observed physically, both full and action-local.
physical_contract.cold: Canonical SHA256-sealed <=8192-byte snapshots at steps 43,67,89 and end. Byte-identical round trip, all 24 predictions identical, tamper rejection, no future information.
physical_contract.no_leakage: No hidden gates, private phases, ground truth audit labels, causal source seed, or context labels may enter learning, choosing, module switching, snapshots or control updates.

arms: module_active: module-wise archive with active physical diagnostics
module_no_retrieval_on_active: same archive mechanism and paid candidate trace, but no archived slot reactivation
sl14_full_bank_on_active: frozen unmodified SL14 Fingerprint full-context bank on same actual candidate trace
independent_bayes_on_active: frozen independently coded SL14 six-gate decayed Bayesian control on candidate trace
rolling_window_on_active: frozen independent SL14 last-18-event causal gate fitter on candidate trace
module_passive: module-wise archive with fixed post-48 physical action t%3; equal charged budget, different information

algorithm.memory: For each of 3 actions: <=3 archive slots; each stores six integer gate-error accumulators over genuinely observed outcomes, observation count, four-bit physical pair-coverage mask, and earliest causal-event index. Per-action bounded 4-event witness windows; total <=9 module slots. No full episodes, hidden labels or oracle truth.
algorithm.update: Only physical (public x, legal action a, observed changed-bit) updates exactly the corresponding module and increases a global paid causal-event count; input perturbations do not update a module. Current physical event may trigger switching before adding its outcome to the newly active slot; no retroactive training or repeated action.
algorithm.selection: On a full 4-event window for the same action with >=2 distinct actually observed action-local input pairs and >=3 physical mistakes by the current slot, compare archived slot hits. Reactivate an archived slot only if >=3/4 correct, >=2 more window hits than current and >=3 earlier actual charged observations; otherwise open a fresh slot if capacity remains. Tie: greatest hit advantage then lowest slot ID. No global bank switch and no other module's state changes. Failed conditions mean no switch.
algorithm.safety_veto: An archived slot's predictions must satisfy the full witness evidence thresholds separately for the affected action; shared A/B submodules cannot authorize retrieval of an unobserved C module. When no archive earns a witness, retain current or create a new module slot. Module switch identity never uses evaluator labels.
algorithm.prediction: Cached best-six-rule gate per active module slot, deterministic minimum accumulated mismatches then lowest rule ID, refreshed only on that module's genuine observation. Query of unseen action/input pair uses the learned rule, not a table lookup.
algorithm.choice: After t48 score each action from: 10*number of different cached predictions across non-active sufficiently observed slots + 2*ambiguity of best two cached rules in active slot + 1 if active slot has not physically seen the action-local pair. Break ties by fixed step-dependent cyclic ordering. Never consult evaluator truth or hidden labels.
algorithm.provenance: Log each genuinely earned per-action module reactivation and new-module birth; evaluator-only classify false retrieval if archived module prediction contradicts the actual hidden current action law for any of its four public input-pair patterns; count ABAB A2/B2/MIXED A4 separately only when a previously active earned module is reactivated after real physical witnesses.
algorithm.efficiency: Per-step action ranking uses cached active/archived gates and per-module state; avoid rescoring all six rules across all banks for every choice. Measure physical learner+selector CPU including actual observe/choose, excluding evaluator/serialization only as in SL14. Report whole-process cost separately.

primary_frozen_thresholds.custody: All 32x6x96 physical steps and exact paired state/action/after ledger SHA; cold checks; no hidden truth; no paid-action omissions; no prereg mutation; same non-timing JSON across Linux/Windows; mandatory final exact-SHA full regression and G29 atlas; original results in Actions not ChatGPT Library.

classification: PASS only if every frozen threshold and provenance/custody contract holds; even then DEV_SIGNAL_NOT_SCIENCE, not native model SCIENTIFIC_PASS. If measurable but thresholds fail: MIXED_DEV/NO-GO; otherwise NEGATIVE_DEV/NO-GO; invalid if physical or source custody violates freeze. Absolutely no post-result threshold/seed/mechanism retuning.
acceptance: Only synthetic development. Scientific first-use is a separately controlled prospective event after prereg and implementation preflight; code/CI success is not acceptance. Any native integration requires independent replication, matched compute and new authorization.
isolation: Draft unmerged descendant of PR #996. No main/accepted ref mutation, native Yggdrasil model/owner/loop, Forge, Wingless, Hybrid, weight programming, controllers, workstation, scheduled tasks, paid API or live data. Keep experimental receipts exclusively in GitHub Actions and repo.
